title: Two glazing films on pairs of windows
intro: Eight offices each have two identical windows side by side; one got film A and the other film B, by a coin toss. The solar heat gain through each window (W/m²) was measured at noon on the same day. The two windows of an office are natural pairs: the paired t on d = A − B, H₀: μ_d = 0 against H₁: μ_d ≠ 0 at α = 0.05.
